banner: Modelled bit flips on toy designs. "After" numbers are exhaustive simulations of reference gate mappings written by the tool, not of a Yosys netlist, unless a row says so. Not a security proof.

labels.MEASURED: simulated here, exhaustively, on the netlist named in the row
labels.RECORDED: copied from a file already in the repository; not re-run here
labels.UNTESTED-HERE: needs Yosys; the generated script and cloud/run_cloud.sh produce it
labels.ASSUMED: a modelling choice or unit weight, stated where used

suggestions.title: Sparse state word as output + Voter placement + More compare copies
plain: Replace the 2-bit state and the decoded output by an 8-bit state word that is the output (as rtl/v1.v, v2.v do).

Remove the single voter net in front of the state register. Either each state bit gets its own kept voter (per_bit_and) or each bit is driven by one copy and the consumer comparing the whole word is the voter (owner).
Add compare copies that own state bits. Each copy is one more net the attacker has to flip on the compare path.
suggestions.evidence: no attack with <= 1 flips on all 3 unmerged reference mappings, all wrong inputs, any number of cycles
suggestions.needs: copies kept separate through synthesis (script provided)
suggestions.note: The fix changes what boot_word shows before the decision (F0/CC instead of 69); a consumer that tests == 0x96 is unaffected.

suggestions.title: Sparse state word as output + Voter placement + More compare copies + Check copy with infection / alarm latch + State encoding
plain: Replace the 2-bit state and the decoded output by an 8-bit state word that is the output (as rtl/v1.v, v2.v do).

Remove the single voter net in front of the state register. Either each state bit gets its own kept voter (per_bit_and) or each bit is driven by one copy and the consumer comparing the whole word is the voter (owner).
Add compare copies that own state bits. Each copy is one more net the attacker has to flip on the compare path.
Add a compare copy that owns no bit and an alarm: if any two compare blocks disagree the reject word is forced (infect); the sticky variant latches the alarm in a flop that keeps forcing reject.

Choose the armed / idle code words so that turning any state the wrong-key run passes through into the accept word needs changes in bits driven by as many different compare copies as possible. Generalises the manual 0xCC -> 0xA5 change (rtl/v2e.v).
